name: agent-crossfeed
description: Hands execution work from Claude Code to the Codex CLI before Claude's 5-hour window runs out.

mode.title: Crossfeed mode
mode.description: Choose automatic routing, always hand off eligible work with headroom, or turn steering off.

effort.title: Codex reasoning effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for work handed to Codex.

model.title: Codex model
model.description: Model for work handed to Codex. Leave empty to use Codex's own default.

eligibleTypes.title: Eligible agent types
eligibleTypes.description: Comma-separated subagent types whose briefs can be handed to Codex.

stretchCalls.title: Long-stretch reminder
stretchCalls.description: Main-loop tool calls before a hand-off reminder when pressure is high.

codexStopPercent.title: Codex stop percentage
codexStopPercent.description: Stop handing off new work when a long Codex quota window reaches this percentage.

timeoutMinutes.title: Job timeout in minutes
timeoutMinutes.description: Maximum time for each job handed to Codex.
